description: List cryptocurrencies supported by SimpleSwap. Filter with query (ticker, network or name) and page with offset/limit. The full list has thousands of entries and each response is cut at about 20 000 characters regardless of limit: when truncated is true, call again with offset=nextOffset, or narrow the list with query. Pass ticker and network together to get one currency with full details: address validation, extra id, explorers and warnings.

limit.description: Upper bound on items to return. The response is also cut by size, so fewer may come back: check truncated and continue with nextOffset.

offset.description: Index of the first item to return. Default 0.

query.description: Case-insensitive filter by ticker, network or name, e.g. "usdt" or "tron".

name: simpleswap_list_currencies

currencies.description: Summary fields only, unless ticker and network were given: then one full record.

truncated.description: true when more items exist; continue with nextOffset.

title: List currencies
